facts.fact: 米奇被手铐电得嘶了一声，紧接着又是一下。
facts.anchor: MITCH hissed in pain as the cuffs shocked him again

facts.fact: 试到第三次，他放弃了这个办法。
facts.anchor: he gave up on the method after the third try

facts.fact: 视线恢复对焦后，他看见右上角固定着一台摄像头，黑色的镜头朝他偏过来。
facts.anchor: he saw the camera affixed to the upper right corner

facts.fact: 他抬手把摄像头从车顶扯了下来，露出后面的电线。
facts.anchor: ripped the device out of the ceiling, exposing the wires behind

facts.fact: 电流穿过他之后，手铐上冒起一缕细烟。
facts.anchor: a thin line of smoke was rising from the cuffs

facts.fact: 手铐终于落到车厢地板上时，他弯下身，松了一口气。
facts.anchor: When the cuffs finally hit the van floor, he sagged, doubled over in relief.

facts.fact: 车门被推开时他先绷紧身体，认定门外是诺亚，来把没做完的事做完。
facts.anchor: certain it was Noah, come to finish what he’d started

facts.fact: 他开口只出来一个名字，句尾挑成了问句。
facts.anchor: the end turned up into a question
